title: Jade Cocoon HD Remaster (PC)
author: Slydini7
selftext:
Sneak peek at the WIP. Dropping a more in depth video soon to cover all the features, then the V1 release before Xmas. More features described in the youtube description. AI assisted coding project, made using Claude and Codex, and various upscaling tools. NON-COMMERCIAL project. 

Looking for artists, fans, beta-testers, coders etc. Anybody who would like to contribute to the project, or simply participate in the community, let me know. There's a facebook group and discord server. DM me for details. Ask me anything.
